top_categories.workout_context: 16,400ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
126ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Sportful Dolomiti Race, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Sportful Dolomiti Race's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At mile 60 of 130, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Road-specific control matters at Sportful Dolomiti Race. Practice on paved Dolomite mountain passes: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 130 miles.
16,400ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Sportful Dolomiti Race. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 130 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Low-cadence force work supports 16,400ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 16,400ft of climbing on paved Dolomite mountain passes does to your power file on race day.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Sportful Dolomiti Race. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Sportful Dolomiti Race’s 130 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Sportful Dolomiti Race includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing. Manghen summit (2,047m): 8-12C with wind — the Dolomites' exposed upper reaches; Dolomite thunderstorms build rapidly — lightning at altitude is a genuine hazard.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Sportful Dolomiti Race rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved dolomite mountain passes to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 130 miles of paved dolomite mountain passes in Feltre, Belluno, Veneto, Italy.
